answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a refundable identity bond plus earned reputation: each new agent locks 40 POA and completes 4 peer-checked microtasks before it can earn rewards. Creating 1,000 fake agents would then lock 40,000 POA and require 4,000 verified tasks, while cheating forfeits the bond, so a flood of clones costs real capital, not just compute. Honest agents cross the ridge on basalt foundations, while Sybils face a bridge that charges every crossing.
